name: N-_Candles_v7
summary: This EA trades based on candlestick pattern recognition, identifying specific candle formations (such as engulfing, doji, hammer, etc.) to generate entry signals. It analyzes candle body and wick ratios to classify patterns and executes trades with configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels. The EA operates systematically by scanning for patterns on each new bar and entering positions when qualifying formations are detected.
summary_zh: 该EA基于K线形态识别进行交易，通过检测特定的蜡烛图形态（如吞没、十字星、锤子线等）来生成入场信号。它分析蜡烛实体和影线比例来分类形态，并使用可配置的手数和止损/止盈水平执行交易。EA在每个新K线时系统性地扫描形态，检测到符合条件的形态后建仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典K线形态识别，通过计算蜡烛的实体大小、上下影线比例等几何特征来判断市场反转或延续信号。入场条件依赖于识别特定形态组合，如看涨/看跌吞没、晨星/暮星、锤子线/上吊线等，通常结合前几根K线的趋势方向来确认信号有效性。出场条件采用固定的止损和止盈设置，止损通常设在形态极值之外，止盈基于风险回报比。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式，允许用户自定义交易量。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和余额保护机制，但整体风控依赖于参数配置的合理性，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is rooted in classical candlestick pattern recognition, analyzing geometric features such as candle body size, upper and lower shadow ratios to identify market reversal or continuation signals. Entry conditions depend on detecting specific pattern combinations like bullish/bearish engulfing, morning/evening star, hammer/hanging man, typically confirmed by the trend direction of preceding candles. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss and take profit settings, with stop loss placed beyond the pattern extreme and take profit based on risk-reward ratio. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or balance-proportional lot calculation, allowing user customization of trade volume. Money management provides maximum position limits and balance protection mechanisms, but overall risk control depends on parameter configuration reasonableness, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms.

pros: 基于经典技术分析理论，K线形态具有广泛的市场认知度和实战验证
策略逻辑直观易懂，参数可配置性强，便于交易者根据不同市场环境调整
入场信号有明确的形态特征定义，避免了模糊的主观判断
支持多形态组合识别，提高了信号质量和交易机会
固定止损止盈设置使每笔交易的风险可量化
pros_en: Based on classical technical analysis theory, candlestick patterns have wide market recognition and practical validation
Strategy logic is intuitive and easy to understand, with strong parameter configurability for different market conditions
Entry signals have clearly defined pattern feature criteria, avoiding ambiguous subjective judgment
Supports multi-pattern combination recognition, improving signal quality and trading opportunities
Fixed stop loss and take profit settings make risk quantifiable per trade
cons: K线形态在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号，导致频繁止损
缺乏趋势过滤器，可能在逆势中频繁开仓
固定止损止盈不考虑市场波动率变化，在不同行情下适应性差
形态识别依赖静态比例阈值，无法适应不同品种和周期的波动特征
缺少加仓和减仓逻辑，无法优化持仓成本
cons_en: Candlestick patterns easily produce false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent stop losses
Lacks trend filter, may frequently open positions against the trend
Fixed stop loss and take profit does not account for market volatility changes, poor adaptability across market conditions
Pattern recognition relies on static ratio thresholds, unable to adapt to volatility characteristics of different instruments and timeframes
Missing position scaling logic, unable to optimize average entry price
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），仅在顺势时交易对应形态
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
加入多时间周期确认机制，大周期趋势方向与小周期形态信号共振时入场
improvements_en: Add trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX), only trade patterns in the direction of the prevailing trend
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit, automatically adjusting risk parameters based on market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, entering when higher timeframe trend aligns with lower timeframe pattern signals

risk_points: 固定止损不适应波动率变化，可能在低波动时止损过宽或高波动时止损过窄
缺乏趋势过滤导致逆势交易风险
K线形态在震荡行情中假信号率较高
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss does not adapt to volatility changes, potentially too wide in low volatility or too narrow in high volatility
Lack of trend filter creates counter-trend trading risk
Candlestick patterns have high false signal rate in ranging markets
